newsitem.title: GERMANY: Allianz at record high on Goldman upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Allianz at record high on Goldman upgrade.

text.p: Shares in Allianz AG on Thursday reached a new record high after investment bank Goldman Sachs raised its rating on the German insurer to market outperformer from market performer.

Allianz shares were up 158 marks ($96.31) at 3,072 marks, or up about five percent, after reaching a new record high at 3,085 marks. The 30-share DAX index was up 22.25 points at 3,021.45 points, or up 0.74 percent.
Traders said the Goldman upgrade had sparked fresh interest in Allianz with relatively high volumes for the stock. By 1030 GMT, some 14,000 shares in Allianz had been traded.
A Goldman spokeswoman confirmed the upgrade had been issued on Thursday but the analyst who issued the report was not immediately available for comment.
